chunks: I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the word of God, Majestic is His Majesty:
'God has promised those of you who believe and do righteous deeds that He will make them successors in the earth, just as He made successors those who came before them'

key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةُ: The Imams — referring to the twelve Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt as the divinely appointed successors
key_terms.جَلَّ جَلَالُهُ: Majestic is His Majesty — an honorific epithet used when referring to God in classical Arabic
key_terms.لَيَسْتَخْلِفَنَّهُمْ: He will surely make them successors/caliphs — the emphatic future tense indicates a divine guarantee

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about Quran 24:55 and who are the promised successors on earth?
ai.summary: Abdullah ibn Sinan reports asking Imam al-Sadiq (AS) about Quran 24:55 — the Divine promise to make believers successors (caliphs) on earth. The Imam's response is succinct and definitive: 'They are the Imams.' This interpretation situates the Imamate as the fulfillment of God's covenant with the believing community, framing the Imams as the legitimate heirs of divine vicegerency on earth — a central doctrine of Shia theology.
word_analysis: He will surely make them successors
